signals.thesis: Casey's General Stores surging +20.3% to new 52-week high on massive volume after multiple analyst upgrades (Morgan Stanley upgrade to Buy, Stephens reiterate Overweight $900 target, Goldman Sachs $695 target). Technical breakout above all moving averages with volume confirmation. Q3 FY2026 beat drove the catalyst. Convenience store sector is defensive in RISK-OFF, benefiting from consumer staples rotation as SPX drops -1.62% and NASDAQ -1.98%.

Murphy USA breaking to new 52-week high ($614.13) with +10% surge on strong earnings momentum. Convenience store/gas station operator benefiting from same defensive rotation as CASY. Forward P/E 20.9x reasonable for consistent growth. RSI 71.0 at the limit but below the 72 cap. Volume spike confirms institutional participation. Benefits from lower fuel costs and stable consumer spending on non-discretionary items.

Consumer Staples ETF breaking above all moving averages (EMA20=83.69, EMA50=83.63, EMA200=82.32) as defensive rotation accelerates. Staples sector outperforming by +2.5% relative to SPX today as risk-off positioning intensifies. MACD bullish crossover confirms trend. VIX at 22.22 and crisis probability at 52.3% make this the textbook defensive allocation. RSI 59.8 provides ample room to run without overextension risk.

Healthcare ETF continuing breakout above all moving averages for the second consecutive session. XLV is the sector rotation beneficiary as investors flee tech (-1.98% NASDAQ) into quality healthcare. LLY, UNH, and JNJ all contributing to sector strength. MACD positive (1.69 vs signal 1.10) confirms momentum. Crisis probability at 52.3% makes healthcare the natural defensive hedge. Carried forward from yesterday's scan at lower entry after market pullback.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
